[P2] Allow newly opened replay segments to complete

A parallel branch can finish a large-result child, then resume a timed wait within the same invocation while another branch remains running. Re-entering that child with `ReplayChildren=True` opens a fresh span for the same operation ID. This guard suppresses its subsequent End because the first segment already populated the ledger. The new segment remains `STARTED`/`UNSET` until invocation cleanup, losing its successful outcome and correct duration. Track completion of newly opened context segments separately from duplicate checkpoint observations, and add a timed-resume regression covering this sequence.
